description: Product metric represented by the backtest row
validation_rule: Must be HDD - EDB or HDD - Basilisk; SSD-Phoenix is not eligible

description: Scenario represented by the backtest row
validation_rule: Must be Enterprise or Consumer for HDD - EDB and Basilisk for HDD - Basilisk

description: Region or Forest grain of the series
validation_rule: Must be Region or Forest and must match the governed source combination

description: Raw key identifying the series
validation_rule: Must be nonblank; raw casing is preserved and matching is case-insensitive

description: Display label for the series
validation_rule: Must be nonblank and map one-to-one to series_key within a metric/scenario/granularity combination

description: Target date for the actual and forecast point; supports History Window filtering
validation_rule: Must parse as ISO date and fall inside the governed actual window for the combination

description: Observed actual paired with the model forecast
validation_rule: Must be finite observed data; never simulated padded zero-filled or model-derived

description: One of the 15 authorized AEGIS models
validation_rule: Must match exactly one model_name in backtest_v2_model_contract.csv with include_in_viewer TRUE

description: Model role in the governed comparison
validation_rule: Must be baseline or challenger and agree with the model contract

description: Viewer grouping for model selection
validation_rule: Must be growth_baseline statistical machine_learning or lightweight_neural and agree with the model contract

description: Point forecast generated at the rolling origin
validation_rule: Must be finite and must originate from an authorized model run

description: Distinguishes historical evaluation from production forecasts
validation_rule: Must equal backtest for every row

description: Forecast horizon from the rolling origin to the target date
validation_rule: Must be an integer from 1 through 30 and equal date minus forecast_start_date

description: Rolling-origin date used to generate the forecast
validation_rule: Must parse as ISO date and precede date by horizon_days

description: Unique identifier for the model execution batch
validation_rule: Must be nonblank and trace to an authorized R8-FIX-3 run manifest

description: Provenance path of the generated or legacy source artifact
validation_rule: Must be nonblank and resolve to a governed artifact recorded in the assembly manifest

description: Marks baseline models
validation_rule: Must be TRUE exactly for models classified as baseline

description: Marks challenger models
validation_rule: Must be TRUE exactly for models classified as challenger

description: Records whether the model result is governed as deferred
validation_rule: Must be TRUE or FALSE and must not be used to hide a missing model result

description: Marks the selected champion for the represented combination
validation_rule: Must be recomputed per metric/scenario/granularity scope and never copied from another scope

description: Governed model risk or decision status
validation_rule: Must use the existing governed vocabulary and must be nonblank

description: Optional lower prediction interval
validation_rule: May be blank; when populated it must be less than or equal to forecast_value

description: Optional upper prediction interval
validation_rule: May be blank; when populated it must be greater than or equal to forecast_value

description: Optional prediction interval confidence level
validation_rule: May be blank; when populated it must be between 0 and 1 and both bounds must be populated

description: Links the actual value to its governed extraction
validation_rule: Must be nonblank and reconcile to the R6 extraction lineage for the actual row
